triceps-pushdown-bar.setup: Attach a straight or V-bar to a high pulley and stand close, holding the bar at chest height with elbows by your sides.
steps: Grip the bar shoulder-width, palms down, and pin your elbows to your ribs.
Press the bar down until your arms are fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment at the bottom.
Let the bar rise slowly until your forearms are just past parallel.
cues: Elbows stay glued to your sides
Keep your chest up and torso still
Control the bar on the way up
mistakes: Leaning over the bar and using body weight
Letting elbows drift forward or flare out
triceps-pushdown-bar.breathing: Breathe out as you push or lift, and in as you return.

single-arm-cable-pushdown.setup: Set a high pulley with a single handle and stand side-on to it, holding the handle with your elbow tucked in.
steps: Hold the handle with a palm-down or neutral grip, elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your upper arm still and press the handle down until your arm is straight.
Squeeze the triceps briefly at the bottom.
Return slowly until your forearm is just past parallel to the floor.
cues: Upper arm stays pinned to your side
Stay tall and do not twist
mistakes: Swinging the shoulder to drive the weight down
Using a weight that makes your elbow drift forward
single-arm-cable-pushdown.breathing: Breathe out as you push or lift, and in as you return.

overhead-cable-triceps-extension.setup: Attach a rope to a low or mid pulley, face away from the stack, and hold the rope behind your head with a split stance.
steps: Grip the rope, raise your elbows beside your ears and lean slightly forward.
Keep your upper arms still and straighten your elbows to press the rope forward and up.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
Bend your elbows slowly to return behind your head.
cues: Elbows point forward, not flared out
Brace your core, do not arch your back
Feel a deep stretch behind the head
mistakes: Letting elbows flare wide
Arching your lower back as you press
overhead-cable-triceps-extension.breathing: Breathe in as you lower the rope, out as you extend.

overhead-dumbbell-triceps-extension.setup: Sit or stand holding one dumbbell with both hands, pressed overhead with your arms straight.
steps: Cup the top plate of the dumbbell with both palms and lock your arms overhead.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and bend them to lower the weight behind your head.
Lower until you feel a good stretch in the triceps.
Straighten your arms to press back to the top.
cues: Keep elbows close to your ears
mistakes: Flaring elbows out to the sides
Arching the back to lift a too-heavy weight
overhead-dumbbell-triceps-extension.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press up.

skull-crusher.setup: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ-bar over your chest with arms straight and a narrow grip.
steps: Lie back with feet planted and the bar above your shoulders, arms straight.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Stop just above your forehead or slightly behind your head.
Straighten your elbows to press the bar back up.
cues: Upper arms stay vertical and still
mistakes: Letting elbows flare and drift wide
Lowering too fast, which stresses the elbows
skull-crusher.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you extend.

dumbbell-skull-crusher.setup: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight above your chest, palms facing each other.
steps: Press the dumbbells up with arms straight and palms facing in.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
Lower until your forearms are about parallel to the floor or slightly past.
Straighten your elbows to return to the start.
mistakes: Using too heavy a weight and swinging the arms
Letting the dumbbells drift toward your face
dumbbell-skull-crusher.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you extend.

jm-press.setup: Lie on a flat bench under a barbell in a rack, with a grip just inside shoulder-width and a spotter if possible.
steps: Unrack the bar and hold it over your lower chest with arms nearly straight.
Let your elbows bend forward so the bar travels toward your chin or upper chest.
Stop when your forearms are roughly vertical, elbows pointing forward.
Press the bar back up by straightening your elbows.
cues: Bar path is short and controlled
Use a spotter and light weight
mistakes: Going too heavy, which risks dropping the bar on your face
Flaring elbows out like a normal bench press
jm-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press up.

triceps-kickback.setup: Hold a dumbbell in one hand, hinge forward with a flat back, and rest your other hand on a bench for support.
steps: Raise your upper arm so it is parallel to your torso, elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Keep the upper arm fixed and straighten your elbow to push the dumbbell back.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
Bend your elbow slowly to return.
cues: Upper arm stays level with your back
Flat back, neck in line with spine
mistakes: Swinging the weight with momentum
Letting the elbow drop during the rep
triceps-kickback.breathing: Breathe out as you push or lift, and in as you return.

bench-dip.setup: Sit on the edge of a bench with hands beside your hips, fingers forward, and legs out in front.
steps: Slide your hips off the bench and support yourself on straight arms.
Bend your elbows straight back to lower your body about 90 degrees at the elbows.
Keep your back close to the bench the whole time.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms.
cues: Shoulders stay down, away from ears
Keep hips close to the bench
mistakes: Lowering too deep, which strains the shoulders
Flaring elbows out to the sides
bench-dip.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press up.

triceps-dip.setup: Grip parallel bars and support yourself with straight arms, body upright, knees bent and feet behind you.
steps: Start with arms locked out and shoulders pulled down.
Keep your torso fairly upright and elbows tucked as you lower.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press up until your arms are straight.
cues: Stay upright to target the triceps
Elbows tucked close to your body
mistakes: Leaning forward, which shifts work to the chest
Dropping too deep and straining the shoulders
triceps-dip.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press up.

wrist-curl.setup: Sit on a bench with forearms resting on your thighs, palms up, a dumbbell in each hand with wrists hanging past your knees.
steps: Let the dumbbells roll down to your fingertips.
Curl your fingers closed and lift the weight by bending your wrists up.
Squeeze your forearms at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
cues: Forearms stay flat on your thighs
Use a light weight, slow tempo
mistakes: Lifting your forearms off your legs
Using too heavy a weight with jerky reps
wrist-curl.breathing: Breathe steadily; breathe out as you curl up.

reverse-wrist-curl.setup: Sit on a bench with forearms on your thighs, palms down, holding light dumbbells with wrists hanging past your knees.
steps: Start with your wrists bent down and the weights hanging.
Extend your wrists to raise the back of your hands toward the ceiling.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.
cues: Go light, these muscles are small
mistakes: Using weight that makes you swing your arms
Cutting the range of motion short
reverse-wrist-curl.breathing: Breathe steadily; breathe out as you lift.

behind-the-back-wrist-curl.setup: Stand holding a barbell behind your thighs with an underhand grip, arms straight and hands shoulder-width apart.
steps: Let the bar roll down to your fingertips.
Curl your fingers shut and lift the bar by bending your wrists.
Squeeze at the top without moving your arms.
Lower the bar slowly back down.
mistakes: Bending the elbows or swinging the bar
Using a load you cannot hold safely
behind-the-back-wrist-curl.breathing: Breathe steadily; breathe out as you curl.

wrist-roller.setup: Stand holding a wrist roller bar with both hands, arms extended in front at shoulder height, weight hanging on the rope.
steps: Grip the bar overhand with arms straight out in front.
Roll the bar toward you by twisting your wrists until the weight reaches the bar.
Reverse the roll slowly to lower the weight back down.
Rest, then repeat in the other direction if desired.
cues: Keep arms level at shoulder height
Use only your wrists and forearms
mistakes: Letting your shoulders and arms sag
Using a weight that is too heavy
wrist-roller.breathing: Breathe steadily throughout; do not hold your breath.

dead-hang.setup: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it overhand slightly wider than shoulder-width, using a box if needed to reach it.
steps: Grab the bar and step off so your feet leave the floor.
Hang with arms straight and shoulders gently pulled down.
Hold the position for the target time.
Step down onto a box or lower yourself carefully when done.
mistakes: Letting shoulders shrug up to your ears
Swinging or kipping during the hold
dead-hang.breathing: Breathe slowly and steadily; do not hold your breath.

plate-pinch.setup: Stand holding two smooth weight plates stacked together, smooth sides out, pinched between your fingers and thumb.
steps: Pinch the plates together by their edges with one hand, thumb on one side.
Lift them off the floor and stand tall with your arm by your side.
Hold for the target time.
Lower them under control and rest.
cues: Squeeze hard with fingers and thumb
Hold over a mat in case of drops
mistakes: Dropping plates onto your feet
Using plates too heavy to hold safely
plate-pinch.breathing: Breathe steadily; do not hold your breath.

plank.setup: Lie face down, then prop yourself on your forearms with elbows under shoulders and legs straight, toes on the floor.
steps: Lift your body into one straight line from head to heels.
Tighten your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Look at the floor and keep your neck neutral.
Hold for the target time.
cues: Imagine pulling elbows toward your toes
mistakes: Letting the hips sag and arch the lower back
Piking the hips too high
plank.breathing: Breathe slowly and steadily; do not hold your breath.

side-plank.setup: Lie on your side and prop up on one forearm with elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked or staggered.
steps: Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Keep your top arm on your hip or reach it toward the ceiling.
Hold without letting your hips drop.
Lower, then repeat on the other side.
cues: Push the floor away with your forearm
Head in line with your spine
mistakes: Letting the hips sag toward the floor
Rolling the torso forward or backward
side-plank.breathing: Breathe slowly and steadily; do not hold your breath.

copenhagen-plank.setup: Set a bench about knee height and lie on your side, forearm on the floor, top leg resting on the bench with your lower leg free.
steps: Place your top leg on the bench, inner knee or ankle for support.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Raise your bottom leg to meet the bench or hover under it.
Hold, then lower and switch sides.
cues: Squeeze the top leg into the bench
mistakes: Starting too advanced and straining the groin
Letting hips drop or rotate forward
copenhagen-plank.breathing: Breathe slowly and steadily; do not hold your breath.

crunch.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat, and hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
steps: Brace your abs and curl your ribs toward your hips.
Lift your shoulder blades off the floor, keeping your lower back down.
Squeeze your abs briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without letting your head drop.
cues: Short curl, not a full sit-up
Eyes on the ceiling, chin off chest
mistakes: Yanking your head forward with your hands
Using momentum instead of your abs
crunch.breathing: Breathe out as you crunch up, in as you lower.

cable-crunch.setup: Kneel facing a high pulley with a rope attached, holding the rope at either side of your head.
steps: Hold the rope by your ears and sit your hips back over your heels.
Curl your chest toward your hips, rounding your spine.
Squeeze your abs hard at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without sitting back.
cues: Round the spine, do not just bend the hips
Pull with the abs, not the arms
mistakes: Pulling with the arms and bending at the hips
Using a weight so heavy that form breaks down
cable-crunch.breathing: Breathe out as you crunch down, in as you return.

machine-crunch.setup: Sit in the ab crunch machine, adjust the seat so the pivot lines up with your waist, and grip the handles.
steps: Sit tall with feet secured and handles in hand.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Squeeze at the bottom for a second.
Return slowly until your abs are stretched, keeping tension.
cues: Curl the ribs toward the hips
mistakes: Pushing with the arms or legs
Letting the weight stack slam down
machine-crunch.breathing: Breathe out as you crunch, in as you return.

decline-sit-up.setup: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured under the pads and arms crossed on your chest.
steps: Lie back with knees slightly bent and arms across your chest.
Curl your torso up, bringing your chest toward your thighs.
Pause at the top with your back tall.
Lower slowly until your shoulder blades near the bench.
cues: Curl up one vertebra at a time
mistakes: Yanking the neck with your hands
Dropping down fast and bouncing at the bottom
decline-sit-up.breathing: Breathe out as you sit up, in as you lower.

hanging-leg-raise.setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight, legs together.
steps: Hang still with your shoulders gently engaged.
Tilt your pelvis up and raise your straight legs in front of you.
Lift to hip height or higher without swinging.
Lower slowly to a controlled hang.
cues: Curl your pelvis up, not just the legs
mistakes: Swinging to build momentum
Using only the hip flexors with an arched back
hanging-leg-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you raise your legs, in as you lower.

hanging-knee-raise.setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight, legs hanging.
steps: Hang still with shoulders engaged.
Bend your knees and pull them up toward your chest.
Curl your pelvis up at the top and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly to a straight hang.
cues: Tuck the hips up under you
Keep the swing out of it
mistakes: Swinging the legs to cheat the rep
Letting your shoulders shrug up
hanging-knee-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you raise your legs, in as you lower.

toes-to-bar.setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight, body still.
steps: Pull your shoulders down and slightly back to start.
Raise your legs, keeping them as straight as you can, toward the bar.
Touch your toes to the bar or get as close as you can.
Lower your legs under control; do not drop.
cues: Pull the bar down toward your thighs
Control the swing on the way down
Build up with knee raises first
mistakes: Dropping the legs and swinging wildly
Attempting it without enough grip strength
toes-to-bar.breathing: Breathe out as you raise your legs, in as you lower.

captains-chair-leg-raise.setup: Stand on the captain's chair, forearms on the pads, back against the pad, and legs hanging.
steps: Press your back into the pad and grip the handles.
Raise your legs, knees bent or straight, up toward hip height or higher.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
cues: Lift with your abs, not momentum
mistakes: Swinging the legs up and down fast
Letting your lower back arch
captains-chair-leg-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you raise your legs, in as you lower.

lying-leg-raise.setup: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips or by your sides.
steps: Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Raise your straight legs until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your back arches.
Repeat without letting your feet rest on the floor.
mistakes: Letting the lower back arch off the floor
Dropping the legs quickly
lying-leg-raise.breathing: Breathe out as you raise your legs, in as you lower.

reverse-crunch.setup: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent to 90 degrees and arms flat by your sides.
steps: Brace your abs and curl your hips off the floor, knees toward your chest.
Lift only a few centimetres, using your abs.
Pause at the top.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
cues: Roll the pelvis up, don't swing
Keep the movement small and slow
Press your hands lightly into the floor
mistakes: Swinging the legs to throw hips up
Using arm push instead of abs
reverse-crunch.breathing: Breathe out as you curl up, in as you lower.

ab-wheel-rollout.setup: Kneel on a mat holding an ab wheel under your shoulders, with your back slightly rounded and abs braced.
steps: Tuck your pelvis and brace your abs hard.
Roll the wheel forward slowly, keeping your hips and shoulders in line.
Go as far as you can without your lower back sagging.
Pull the wheel back by squeezing your abs.
cues: Only go as far as you can control
Slow roll out, slow roll in
mistakes: Letting the lower back sag and arch
Rolling out too far too soon
ab-wheel-rollout.breathing: Breathe in as you roll out, out as you pull back.

dead-bug.setup: Lie on your back with arms straight up and hips and knees bent to 90 degrees.
steps: Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Lower your right arm overhead and left leg toward the floor together.
Stop before your lower back arches.
Return and repeat with the opposite arm and leg.
cues: Lower back stays glued to the floor
Exhale to keep the ribs down
mistakes: Letting the lower back arch away from the floor
Moving too fast
dead-bug.breathing: Breathe out as you extend, in as you return.

hollow-body-hold.setup: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight together.
steps: Press your lower back firmly into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and straight legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold a shallow banana shape with abs tight.
Lower with control when done.
cues: Raise legs higher to make it easier
mistakes: Letting the lower back arch up
Lifting the legs too low to hold form
hollow-body-hold.breathing: Breathe in short, steady breaths; do not hold your breath.

v-up.setup: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and arms extended overhead.
steps: Brace your abs and lift your legs and torso at the same time.
Reach your hands toward your toes, forming a V.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.
mistakes: Using momentum to swing up
Rounding the neck and dropping down fast
v-up.breathing: Breathe out as you rise, in as you lower.

bicycle-crunch.setup: Lie on your back with hands lightly behind your head and legs lifted with knees bent.
steps: Lift your shoulders off the floor and bring your knees in.
Twist to bring your right elbow toward your left knee while extending the right leg.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep going without letting your shoulders rest.
cues: Rotate your ribs, not just the elbows
mistakes: Pulling on the neck with the hands
Going so fast the rotation is lost
bicycle-crunch.breathing: Breathe steadily; breathe out on each twist.

russian-twist.setup: Sit on the floor, lean back about 45 degrees with knees bent and a weight or hands held at your chest.
steps: Lean back with a long spine and feet down or lifted.
Rotate your torso to one side, moving the weight with you.
Rotate to the other side under control.
Continue alternating sides.
cues: Turn from the ribs, not just the arms
Feet down for an easier version
mistakes: Rounding the back and slumping
Swinging the arms instead of turning the torso
russian-twist.breathing: Breathe out on each twist; keep breathing steadily.

pallof-press.setup: Set a cable at chest height and stand side-on to it, holding the handle at your chest with feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Hold the handle with both hands at the centre of your chest.
Press it straight out in front, resisting the cable's pull to rotate.
Hold for a second with arms fully extended.
Bring it back to your chest slowly.
cues: Don't let the cable twist you
mistakes: Letting the torso rotate toward the cable
Standing too close with no tension
pallof-press.breathing: Breathe out as you press, in as you return.

cable-woodchop.setup: Set a cable pulley high or low and stand side-on to it, holding the handle with both hands.
steps: Grip the handle and set your feet wider than your hips.
Pull the cable diagonally across your body, turning your torso.
Pivot your back foot and keep your arms mostly straight.
Return slowly under control.
cues: Rotate from your trunk and hips
mistakes: Using just the arms to yank the cable
Twisting the lower back instead of pivoting
cable-woodchop.breathing: Breathe out as you chop, in as you return.

landmine-rotation.setup: Place a barbell in a landmine holder, stand holding the free end with both hands at chest height, feet shoulder-width.
steps: Hold the end of the bar in front of your chest with straight arms.
Swing the bar in an arc to one side by rotating your torso.
Pivot your feet and keep your arms extended.
Swing back through the middle to the other side.
cues: Turn through hips and torso together
mistakes: Using the arms to push the bar around
Locking the knees and twisting the lower back
landmine-rotation.breathing: Breathe out as you rotate, in as you pass the middle.

suitcase-carry.setup: Stand with a heavy dumbbell in one hand at your side, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Pick up the dumbbell and stand tall with shoulders level.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Walk in a straight line with steady steps.
Set the weight down, then repeat on the other side.
cues: Don't lean toward or away from the weight
mistakes: Leaning sideways to compensate
Letting the shoulder shrug up
suitcase-carry.breathing: Breathe steadily; do not hold your breath.

farmers-carry.setup: Stand between two heavy dumbbells, feet hip-width apart, and pick them up with a neutral spine.
steps: Hinge down, grip the handles, and stand up tall.
Pull your shoulders back and down, and brace your abs.
Walk with short, quick steps for the set distance.
Lower the weights under control.
mistakes: Letting shoulders round forward
Rounding the back when picking up or lowering
farmers-carry.breathing: Breathe steadily; do not hold your breath.

mountain-climber.setup: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and body in a straight line.
steps: Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly in a running motion.
Keep your hands planted and shoulders over your wrists.
mistakes: Letting the hips bounce up high
Dropping the hips and arching the back
mountain-climber.breathing: Breathe in a steady rhythm; do not hold your breath.

stir-the-pot.setup: Place a stability ball on the floor and set yourself in a forearm plank with elbows on the ball.
steps: Get into a plank with forearms on the ball, body straight.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly.
Move the ball in a small circle with your forearms.
Reverse the direction after a few reps.
cues: Squeeze glutes to protect your back
mistakes: Letting the hips sag as the ball moves
Making circles too big to control
stir-the-pot.breathing: Breathe slowly and steadily; do not hold your breath.

dragon-flag.setup: Lie on a bench and grip behind your head, with your shoulders on the bench and legs straight up.
steps: Grip the bench behind your head and lift your hips so you are on your upper back.
Keep your body straight like a plank.
Lower your body slowly, keeping it stiff.
Lift back up using your abs; use bent knees to make it easier.
cues: Body stays rigid like a board
Only lower as far as you can control
mistakes: Folding at the hips instead of staying straight
Going too advanced and straining the lower back
dragon-flag.breathing: Breathe out as you lift, in as you lower.

l-sit.setup: Sit between parallel bars or on the floor with hands beside your hips, palms down and arms straight.
steps: Press your hands down and lock your arms.
Lift your hips and legs off the surface.
Keep your legs straight and parallel to the floor.
Hold, then lower with control.
cues: Push down and shrug shoulders away
Tuck knees to make it easier
mistakes: Letting shoulders hunch up to the ears
Bending the arms and sagging
l-sit.breathing: Breathe in short, steady breaths; do not hold your breath.

side-bend-dumbbell.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand at your side and your other hand on your hip or behind your head.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the weight at your side.
Bend sideways, sliding the dumbbell down your leg.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your side.
Squeeze your obliques to return to upright.
cues: Keep hips and chest facing front
mistakes: Leaning forward or backward as you bend
Using too heavy a weight
side-bend-dumbbell.breathing: Breathe in as you bend, out as you return.

back-squat.setup: Set a barbell on a rack at upper chest height, step under it, and rest it across your upper back with feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Grip the bar, brace your core, and unrack it with a step back.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your whole foot to stand.
mistakes: Letting knees cave inward
Rounding the lower back at the bottom
back-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

low-bar-back-squat.setup: Set a barbell at upper chest height and rest it low across your rear shoulders, with feet shoulder-width and toes slightly out.
steps: Grip the bar tightly, pull it into your back, and brace.
Push your hips back first and lean forward from the hips.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive up, keeping the bar over mid-foot.
mistakes: Letting the chest collapse forward
Letting knees cave in as you stand
low-bar-back-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

front-squat.setup: Set the bar on your front shoulders, elbows high, with a clean grip or crossed arms, feet shoulder-width.
steps: Rest the bar on your shoulders and lift your elbows high.
Brace and lower straight down, knees tracking over toes.
Lower to parallel or deeper while keeping your chest tall.
Drive up while keeping elbows high.
mistakes: Letting elbows drop and the bar roll forward
Rounding the upper back
front-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

paused-squat.setup: Set up as for a normal barbell back squat, bar across your upper back, feet shoulder-width.
steps: Unrack, brace, and squat down under control.
Reach the bottom, with thighs at or below parallel.
Hold the bottom position for 2 to 3 seconds, staying tight.
Drive up out of the hole.
cues: Drive up with a strong chest
mistakes: Relaxing and losing tension in the pause
Bouncing out of the hole
paused-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

box-squat.setup: Place a box or bench behind you at about knee height, set the bar on your back, and stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders.
steps: Brace and sit your hips back to the box.
Lower under control and touch down lightly without dropping.
Stay tight; do not relax on the box.
Drive through your feet to stand.
cues: Sit back, shins stay near vertical
mistakes: Dropping and relaxing on the box
Rocking back to stand instead of driving up
box-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

safety-bar-squat.setup: Set a safety squat bar in a rack, step under it so the pads rest on your shoulders, and grip the handles.
steps: Unrack the bar and step back with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace and sit down and back between your hips.
Lower to at least parallel while keeping your chest tall.
Drive up through your feet.
mistakes: Letting knees cave inward
Losing posture and rounding the upper back
safety-bar-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

zercher-squat.setup: Set the bar in the rack at elbow height and hold it in the crooks of your elbows with arms tight to your torso.
steps: Lift the bar from the rack with elbows bent, hands clasped.
Step back, brace, and squat down between your knees.
Lower to at least parallel while keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your feet.
mistakes: Rounding the back as the bar pulls forward
Letting elbows flare away from the body
zercher-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

goblet-squat.setup: Hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands, elbows pointing down, feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Hold the dumbbell at your chest and brace your core.
Sit down between your legs, pushing knees out.
Lower until your thighs are parallel or deeper, with chest tall.
Push through your feet to stand.
mistakes: Letting heels lift off the floor
Rounding forward at the bottom
goblet-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

hack-squat.setup: Step into the hack squat machine with your back against the pad, feet shoulder-width on the platform, and shoulders under the pads.
steps: Release the safety handles and straighten your legs.
Bend your knees and lower under control.
Lower until your thighs are parallel or deeper, if comfortable.
Press through your whole foot to stand without locking the knees.
cues: Don't lock out hard at the top
mistakes: Letting your hips lift off the pad at the bottom
Locking the knees violently at the top
hack-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

pendulum-squat.setup: Step onto the pendulum squat machine, set your shoulders under the pads, and stand with feet on the platform.
steps: Release the safety and stand tall with a braced core.
Bend your knees and sink into a deep squat as the arm swings.
Lower to a depth that keeps your lower back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand.
mistakes: Letting your lower back round at the bottom
Bouncing out of the bottom
pendulum-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

smith-machine-squat.setup: Set the Smith bar at upper chest height, step under it, and place feet slightly in front of the bar at shoulder-width.
steps: Rest the bar on your upper back and twist to unlock it.
Brace and bend your knees to lower straight down.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel.
Push through your feet to stand, then rack the bar.
cues: Feet slightly forward of the bar
Know where the safety hooks are
mistakes: Placing feet too far back and straining the knees
Rounding the back at the bottom
smith-machine-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

leg-press.setup: Sit in the leg press with your back and hips flat on the pad, feet shoulder-width on the platform.
steps: Release the safety handles with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower the platform by bending your knees toward your chest.
Stop when your knees are at about 90 degrees and your hips stay on the seat.
Press through your whole foot until your legs are almost straight.
cues: Hips and lower back stay on the pad
Do not lock your knees hard
mistakes: Letting hips curl up off the seat at the bottom
Locking the knees at the top under load
leg-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

single-leg-leg-press.setup: Sit in the leg press with your back and hips flat, one foot in the middle of the platform and the other leg relaxed.
steps: Release the safety handles with one foot planted.
Lower the platform under control until your knee is at about 90 degrees.
Keep the knee tracking over your toes.
Press through your foot to near-straight, without locking out.
mistakes: Letting the hips twist or lift off the seat
Letting the knee cave inward
single-leg-leg-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you press.

belt-squat.setup: Fasten the belt around your hips, attach it to the machine or weight, and stand on the platforms with your feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Stand tall to take the weight on the belt.
Bend your knees and sit down between your feet.
Lower until your thighs are at or below parallel.
Drive through your feet to stand.
cues: Stay tall; the load pulls straight down
mistakes: Leaning forward and rounding the back
Letting the knees cave in
belt-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

bodyweight-squat.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out, arms in front or crossed on your chest.
steps: Brace your core and look forward.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand tall.
mistakes: Letting heels lift off the floor
Letting knees collapse inward
bodyweight-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

pistol-squat.setup: Stand on one leg, with the other leg extended in front and arms stretched forward for balance. Hold a support if you need it.
steps: Brace your core and reach your arms forward.
Sit back and lower on your standing leg, free leg held straight out.
Lower as deep as you can while keeping your heel flat.
Drive through your whole foot to stand.
cues: Use a box or TRX for help
mistakes: Letting the knee cave inward
Dropping fast and losing control at the bottom
pistol-squat.breathing: Breathe in at the top, brace, and breathe out as you stand up.

sissy-squat.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a support with one hand, and rise slightly onto your toes.
steps: Hold a support and lift your heels off the floor.
Lean back and let your knees travel forward as you lower.
Lower only as deep as your knees comfortably allow.
Push up by straightening your knees and squeezing your thighs.
cues: Keep body in a straight line
mistakes: Going deeper than your knees can handle
Bending at the hips instead of leaning back
sissy-squat.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

jump-squat.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out, arms ready in front of your chest.
steps: Squat down to a quarter or half-squat depth.
Explode upward, jumping as high as you can.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and bend your knees.
Go straight into the next rep or reset.
mistakes: Landing with stiff, locked knees
Letting knees cave in on landing
jump-squat.breathing: Breathe out as you jump, in as you land.
